title: Known unfixed: bytes and inf/nan JSON schemas use ser_json_* config in the wrong mode
answers: validation schema for bytes says format base64url but model accepts utf-8
val_json_bytes='base64' schema still says format binary
ser_json_inf_nan='strings' schema still says type number
hex bytes not reflected in JSON schema
body:
Symptom: with `val_json_bytes='base64'`, input must be base64 but the validation schema says `format: 'binary'`. With `ser_json_bytes='base64'`, input is still UTF-8 but the validation schema says `format: 'base64url'`. Neither side handles `'hex'`.
Root cause (per PR #13711 description): `pydantic/json_schema.py:GenerateJsonSchema.bytes_schema` reads `ser_json_bytes` in both modes. The validation side should read `val_json_bytes`.
Status: deliberately left unfixed. PR #12841 is rewriting these lines to use `contentMediaType`/`contentEncoding`, and #12104 is still deciding the base64/base64url labels. Check those PRs before changing `bytes_schema`.
Related: with `ser_json_inf_nan='strings'`, floats serialize to "Infinity" but the serialization schema still says `{'type': 'number'}`. This needs a maintainer decision, not just a patch.
Use the same invariant as the temporal fix: serialization mode follows `ser_*`, validation mode follows `val_*`/what the validator accepts.
applies: bytes and float JSON schema generation in pydantic/json_schema.py
